source: Toprank Review Academy (TRA) Nursing Module – Complete Handout

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which lab test monitors heparin therapy?
questions.rationale: Heparin is monitored by aPTT (therapeutic 1.5–2.5 times control); warfarin by PT/INR.
questions.quote: Heparin: Monitor aPTT (activated partial thromboplastin time)

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: What is the usual therapeutic INR range for warfarin?
questions.rationale: Warfarin is monitored by PT/INR, with a usual therapeutic INR of 2.0–3.0.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: What is the antidote for warfarin (Coumadin)?
questions.rationale: Vitamin K reverses warfarin; protamine sulfate reverses heparin.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which teaching is correct for a client on anticoagulants?
questions.rationale: Use a soft toothbrush, avoid aspirin and IM injections, and report bleeding such as black stools.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which drug level is monitored for a client on theophylline?
questions.rationale: Theophylline has a narrow therapeutic range, so serum levels are monitored.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: After an oral mucolytic, what should the client avoid right away?
questions.rationale: Take no fluids directly after oral administration; otherwise increase overall fluid intake.
questions.quote: Take no fluids directly after oral administration

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: How long before allergy skin testing should antihistamines be stopped?
questions.rationale: Discontinue antihistamines four days before allergy skin testing to avoid false negatives.
questions.quote: Discontinue four days before skin testing for allergies

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: When a client uses both a bronchodilator and a steroid inhaler, which is used first?
questions.rationale: Give the bronchodilator first to open airways, then the steroid; rinse the mouth after the steroid.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Anti-inflammatory Drugs (PDF p. 131)

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Why should the client rinse the mouth after a steroid inhaler?
questions.rationale: Rinsing after a steroid inhaler reduces oral candidiasis.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Anti-inflammatory Drugs (PDF p. 131)
questions.quote: Rinse mouth after using steroid inhaler

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A client on thyroid replacement should report which pulse?
questions.rationale: Report a pulse over 100 and toxicity signs such as chest pain, palpitations, and nervousness.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Thyroid Agents (PDF p. 133)
questions.quote: Monitor pulse rate; report pulse rate over 100

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A client on an antithyroid drug should avoid OTC products containing:
questions.rationale: Antithyroid therapy clients avoid OTC drugs containing iodine.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Anti-hyperthyroid Agents (PDF p. 133)

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: How is response to ADH (vasopressin) therapy for diabetes insipidus monitored?
questions.rationale: ADH helps reabsorb water; I&O and BP show response.
questions.quote: Monitor response to therapy: I&O, blood pressure

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A client on a loop diuretic should report which change?
questions.rationale: Loop diuretics can be ototoxic; report hearing changes and change positions slowly.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which teaching applies to sulfonamides for UTI?
questions.rationale: Increase fluids (prevent crystalluria) and avoid direct sunlight.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A transplant client on immunosuppressants should report which early?
questions.rationale: Report early signs of infection such as fever and sore throat; hirsutism is reversible.
questions.quote: Report early signs of infection (fever, sore throat)

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Why should nitrofurantoin tablets not be crushed?
questions.rationale: Nitrofurantoin stains teeth; dilute the suspension and rinse the mouth after.
questions.quote: Do not crush pill because it stains teeth

questions.subject: NP II
questions.topic: Care of the At-Risk and Sick Child
questions.stem: Tetracycline should be avoided in which client?
questions.rationale: Tetracyclines are not for young children or the last half of pregnancy (tooth staining, bone effects).
questions.quote: Not for young children or in last half of pregnancy

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which teaching applies to fluoroquinolones like ciprofloxacin?
questions.rationale: Fluoroquinolones cause photosensitivity and dizziness; avoid sun and hazardous activities.
questions.quote: Fluoroquinolones: Avoid hazardous activities; avoid sunlight

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which sign suggests superinfection during antibiotic therapy?
questions.rationale: Monitor for superinfection signs such as sore throat, fever, and fatigue.
questions.quote: Monitor for signs of superinfection: sore throat, fever, fatigue
